content: असम {%a.%} .²1 Uneven, odd (as a number); असमशीलाः खलु मृगाः <ls>Bv. 1. 2</ls>; mean, contemptible. .²2 Unequal (in space, number or dignity); असमैः समीयमानः <ls>Pt. 1. 74</ls>. .²3 Unequalled, matchless, unsurpassed; समवतारसमैरसमैस्तटैः <ls>Ki. 5. 7</ls>; वाद्यविशेषाणामसमः श्रोता <ls>K. 12</ls>; <ls>Ms. 10. 73</ls>. .²4 Uneven, not level (as ground). .{@-मः@} <ab>N.</ab> of Buddha.
